Not published.** Arthur McInnis · Council · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site: full five-plank `/platform`, plus article hubs read in full (housing, governance, budget, safety). Challenger: no 2022–26 City term, so no Record lines and no incumbent haircut. 2026 plan taken at face value. ## Card

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **said** "Any proposed property tax increase above the rate of inflation will require a mandatory 90-day public consultation period before Council may adopt it." A consultation gate, not a cap, formula, or year-path. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
Downtown order M26 / M27 **—** No Public Order Team, no unified command, no bylaw-hours position. Safety performance contract and community paramedicine are scored on rows 35 and 32, not here. — —
Housing M6 **said** "Any development receiving a rezoning, density bonus, or access to public land must meet minimum unit-mix requirements: a defined percentage of two-bedroom and three-bedroom suites, and a defined percentage of ground-oriented units." Thresholds left to an amended OCP. Missing middle as the default form is the same housing cluster, not a second door. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **said** "When Council approves a budget, the public communication should include an honest estimate of what a typical homeowner, accounting for school tax, regional levies, policing, and debt will likely see on their actual notice." All-in residential communication, not a named combined water/sewer/stormwater Household Bill. Verb FLAG in working notes. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget) retrieved 2026-09-02
Written program — **yes** An authorized campaign site with a five-plank long-form platform (open government and fiscal discipline; neighbourhood planning; housing and tenant protection; transportation; public safety), ten article hubs, biography, donations and volunteer forms. Written and current. No costed city-wide budget, no residential-rate formula, no unit-volume target. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Close 2.0** "Any development receiving a rezoning, density bonus, or access to public land must meet minimum unit-mix requirements: a defined percentage of two-bedroom and three-bedroom suites, and a defined percentage of ground-oriented units." · Commits × Comparable. Family mix named; thresholds "will be set in an amended OCP," so not 25/20/15 and not Aligned. Context, same plank, not a second mark: missing middle (duplexes, triplexes, courtyard housing, townhomes, laneway homes, small apartments) as the preferred growth form. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops **Close 2.0** "The city will not sell municipally owned land for housing. Instead, underused city parcels, including surface parking lots, surplus works yards, and air rights above civic facilities will be offered on long-term nominal leases to housing co-ops and non-profit providers." · Commits × Comparable. 99-year-style leasehold to co-ops/non-profits is the land-bank half, not a named acquisition fund. Civic overbuild (housing feasibility on civic rebuilds) is the same land-for-housing cluster, not a second mark. The civic-land *map* is scored on row 44. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time standard and no AI pre-screening. The "expedited permit stream" sits inside the pattern-book sentence already scored on row 4. "Infrastructure Before Upzoning" (certified capacity report before significant upzoning) is a condition on the approval path, not a clock. FLAG: live profile names the tension with M7 speed; do not invent a dash into Opposed, and do not give this sentence a second mark. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing **Aligned 3.0** "The city will develop a pattern book of pre-approved duplex, triplex, townhome, and laneway home designs available to any applicant, qualifying automatically for an expedited permit stream." · Commits × Same instrument. Designs prioritise family-appropriate unit sizes. Template example sentence, re-sourced from the live `/platform` on this retrieve, not copied from the template card. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty **Close 2.0** "The city will establish a time-limited permit amnesty for suites meeting basic safety standards, paired with a standardised approval package and concierge permitting service." · Commits × Comparable. M8b amnesty is named. Context, same plank, not a second mark: reduced DCC and permit-fee schedule for missing-middle and family-oriented infill. No 5% vacancy target, so not Aligned. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No unified command, co-location, or downtown operations desk. Safety performance contract is scored on row 35. Community paramedicine is scored on row 32. OCP safety benchmarks are the same safety plank, not a Public Order Team. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — Community paramedicine is scored once, on row 32. That is not a civilian crisis-response team dispatched so the wrong responder stops absorbing officer time. No CRCL / IMCRT naming. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. `/platform` and safety hub checked. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. The safety dashboard is scored on row 35, not as M28 targeting. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — No keep / repeal / replace of daytime sheltering rules. North Park and CSWB articles diagnose street disorder; diagnosis without an instrument is a Mention, so a dash. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — No child-focused buffer, no VicPD/CDSA list, no City seizure claim. `/platform` and hubs checked. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — No named-space reclaim protocol, no same-day sidewalk clearing, no night-lighting programme. Compassion-without-accountability is a frame, not an encampment instrument. Mentions dash. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) **Close 2.0** "Any proposed property tax increase above the rate of inflation will require a mandatory 90-day public consultation period before Council may adopt it." · Commits × Comparable. Inflation gate with a public-covenant consultation, not a 6.5/5.0/6-of-9 cap. Do not stamp 10.44 as the current ACTW lock (residential lock is 9.34). Context, same plank, not a second mark: "This is a policy commitment to fiscal discipline not a legal straitjacket." [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — Hub 4 diagnoses a 58.6% jump in municipal debt charges on one notice. That is a diagnosis, not a refund rule, a debt cap, or a supermajority override. Mentions, so a dash. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill **Close 2.0** "When Council approves a budget, the public communication should include an honest estimate of what a typical homeowner, accounting for school tax, regional levies, policing, and debt will likely see on their actual notice." · Commits × Comparable. All-in residential communication is the Household Bill's purpose; water, sewer and stormwater are not named as a combined number. FLAG: the hub frames this as what "residents should demand from the next Council" while he is running for that Council — ambiguity up to Commits, not a dash. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget) retrieved 2026-09-02
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger **Close 2.0** "Formally advocate to the Province for a legislative framework requiring it to fully fund and operate mental health, addictions, and complex care services." · Commits × Comparable. Refusal to keep absorbing provincial care onto the municipal tax base is the downloading goal; no published ledger and no dollar-threshold table, so not Aligned. Context, hub 4, not a second mark: the downloading argument against treating discretionary well-being spend as a legal obligation. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — CRD and regional levies appear on the sample tax notice in hub 4 as a diagnosis of the combined bill, already used toward row 15. No Goldstream / filtration-plant position. Dash. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office — Downtown business liaison is scored once, on row 31, as a security-cost sentence, not as a commercial-vacancy target or Strategic Economic Plan. No 11%→5% vacancy instrument. — —
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour Year-2 gate, no capital-approval dollar threshold. Public-parking replacement (parkades at Centennial Square, Wharf Street, Royal Athletic Park) is a different instrument from M75 short-stay access. FLAG: parking programme exists and is not this cell. Permit-fee relief is already context on row 5. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — Hub 4 challenges the legal basis of the Reconciliation Contribution Fund on the tax notice. That is a process/jurisdiction critique, not a standing G2G table, procurement target, place-name programme, cultural-protocol package, or urban Indigenous liaison. Topic stays in the 12. A dash is unknown, not a fail. Not Opposed: he does not reject Host Nations relations; he rejects an unauthorised fundraising vehicle. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "Any redevelopment that demolishes purpose-built rental housing must replace every demolished unit with a new rental unit on the same site. No net loss of rental inventory." · Commits × Comparable. One-for-one replacement is a demoviction-protection instrument. Context, same plank, not a second mark: lesser-of right of return; tenure-based relocation coordinator. No STR licensing and no indoor-heat standard on the live `/platform` (June internal notes of a 3% STR trigger are not on this retrieve and are not used). M9c struck. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — No rules-based digital allocation, no published waitlist design. `/platform` and hubs checked. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput — Protecting existing rental stock is scored on row 21. Non-market / co-op land is scored on row 2. Hub 1 "build non-market housing" is advocacy without a 50% unsheltered target or STEP throughput. Mentions, so a dash. Not Housing First by name. — —
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — Family unit-mix is scored on row 1. No 500 childcare spaces, no family-doctor recruitment, no 18–25 programme. Professional background is not a source. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools appear only as a capacity item inside "Infrastructure Before Upzoning." That is a Mention of school load, not a standing SD61 agreement. Mentions dash every column. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear as 2026 instruments. `/platform` and hubs checked. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Close 2.0** "Require a published, ranked, dated list of the city's highest-collision locations, updated annually with the city's own data, so residents, not just staff, can see which intersections are next and when." · Commits × Comparable. Ranked injury-severity capital sequence is a Vision Zero operations instrument, not a named Vision Zero audit and not adaptive signals. M39 struck. Context, `/platform` same cluster, not a second mark: emergency-response audit of corridor redesigns and an OCP Emergency Access Overlay. Option F / parking-replacement sentences are not this mark. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety) retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — M23b is transit the City controls (street space, signal priority, shelters, Commission vote). Pressing the Province on the BC Transit funding gap is a Mention of transit, not a City lever, so a dash. Inner Harbour water-transit feasibility and the Island Rail Corridor sit in the same plank and are not a second mark. Walking / sidewalk-gap standard does not appear. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — "Accessibility for those who cannot cycle" inside neighbourhood street-change assessments is a Mention, not an accessibility audit or public-washroom standard. Dash. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "roads come before discretionary programs" sits inside the zero-based sentence already scored on row 41. One sentence, one measure. No pothole clock, no backlog standard. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading **Partial 1.0** "Establish a dedicated city liaison for downtown businesses facing the direct costs of theft, vandalism, and reduced foot traffic." · Commits × Neither. A liaison is an action, not an exposure-based cost-spreading pilot. Face-test Partial, not Close. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
32 M28d community paramedicine **Aligned 3.0** "I will fund a City partnership contribution and formally advocate to the Province to bring community paramedicine to Victoria as a permanent urban program, not another pilot that disappears." · Commits × Same instrument. Jurisdiction note on the same page: BCEHS delivers; the City funds a partnership and advocates. Not double-counted as M26b. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) **Close 2.0** "Pursue the regional and Esquimalt-style integration model seriously, rather than as a talking point sharing specialised units and back-office functions across municipalities frees sworn officers for the front line without waiting on a hiring pipeline that the whole province is competing for." · Commits × Comparable. Regional integration / shared units is the M29b goal with a harder instrument than convene-and-publish; pack forbids binding another force, so not Aligned. Context, `/platform`, not a second mark: "Restore the two cut VicPD positions as an immediate step toward meeting identified staffing pressures." FLAG vs 1 Sep pack Partial 1.0 that used only the restore-two sentence. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety) retrieved 2026-09-02
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. `/platform` and hubs checked. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target **Aligned 3.0** "Convert the həlisət plan from a narrative document into a performance contract. Every major commitment must identify: legal authority, responsible lead body, implementation timeline, measurable target, and projected cost." · Commits × Same as M31c. Context, same plank, not a second mark: real-time public safety dashboard modelled on Hamilton/Toronto; quarterly reporting on crime trends, street disorder, response times, shelter placements. Distinct from the taxpayer capital portal on row 42. No 15% crime-reduction number, so M32 is context only. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues **Close 2.0** "Any rezoning or development permit application affecting a designated or registered heritage property will require an independent Heritage Impact Assessment prepared by a qualified heritage professional at the applicant's cost published as part of the public record before the hearing." · Commits × Comparable. Mandatory HIA is a heritage-standards instrument, not facade grants or a venue lease-bridge. Not Aligned. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — No pedestrian-priority zones, no signature-project shortlist, no referendum on a civic signature. Opposing Option F is a neighbourhood-consent / emergency-access sentence already used as context on row 27, not a pedestrianisation programme. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Local DCC reinvestment into neighbourhood parks sits in the neighbourhood cluster already scored on row 53. No heritage-incentive schedule, ornamental lighting, or parks programme. Dash. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — Crystal Pool is a capital-stewardship critique in hub 4, not an arts/sport funding floor. Dash. — —
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — Shared services, joint procurement and shared back-office with neighbours is a cost-reduction sentence, not competitive testing of City services against a specification. Not M15. Dash, not Partial. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Aligned 3.0** "End automatic annual departmental increases. Every department justifies its baseline spending each year against core service priorities: fire, police, water, sewers, and roads come before discretionary programs." · Commits × Same instrument in substance (zero-based baseline, annually, all departments). Rotating 3–4 areas is not named; annual-all-departments is ZBB, not a weaker cousin. Roads-first language in this sentence is not given a second mark on row 30. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard **Close 2.0** "Launch a publicly accessible digital portal tracking all major capital projects: e.g. Crystal Pool, the Community Safety Plan, street redesigns with budget vs. actual spending updated in real time." · Commits × Comparable. Real-time capital portal, not a quarterly KPI dashboard. Distinct from the safety dashboard on row 35. The \$10 FOI-fee abolition in the same numbered action is scored as context on row 52, not here. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. ZBB is scored on row 41. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation **Close 2.0** "Publish a full public map of every city-owned parcel, including surface parking lots, works yards, air rights, and surplus buildings. Report annually on what each parcel produces in public benefit and whether it meets OCP housing targets before adjacent private land is up-zoned." · Commits × Comparable. Inventory plus a utilization / public-benefit audit is the first half of M69. Missing the sell-or-lease rule for parcels that do not serve an essential public function, so not Aligned. 99-year housing leases are already scored on row 2 and are not a second mark here. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. `/platform` and hubs checked. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. Professional/legal background is not a source. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — Open-data flavour of the taxpayer portal is scored on row 42. No local-tech procurement, public Wi-Fi or EV-charging programme. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic — Urban forest as natural infrastructure (stormwater, heat, flooding) is scored on row 49. No 50%/2030 Climate Leadership Plan delivery, no district energy, no seismic programme. Mentions of climate co-benefits dash. — —
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness **Close 2.0** "A verified pre-development baseline will support a net-positive canopy requirement for new developments." · Commits × Comparable. Canopy instrument named; no 5,000-tree target, no 35% canopy. Context, same numbered action, not a second mark: Garry Oak inventory on public land; mature-tree removal evidence; homeowner stewardship credit. Hub 6 earthquake / emergency-management capacity is the preparedness half of this cluster and is not given a second mark. Mode share is not a separate cell (provincial transit advocacy is dashed on row 28). [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule **Aligned 3.0** "Any amendment to a development application, changes of more than ten per cent to height, density, or permitted uses; removal of community amenity commitments; changes to heritage conditions made after the public hearing has closed will require a pause, staff report, and re-notification before any vote proceeds." · Commits × Same as M78b's 10% material-change rule. No \$25M referendum threshold and no 5-step capital sequence; cluster still Aligned on the named Same instrument. Crystal Pool critique is hub diagnosis, not this rule. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response **Aligned 3.0** "Establish an independent Integrity Commissioner appointed by Council but reporting independently with the authority to receive complaints from any person about breaches of the Code of Conduct by elected officials." · Commits × Same office. Findings published and tabled. No 60-day consultation-response standard (M79b remainder is context, not a second mark). Free-vote covenant and single-meeting model are process sentences, not this cell. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration **Aligned 3.0** "Establish a searchable public registry of all meetings between city staff, Council, and development proponents." · Commits × Same as the lobbyist-registry instrument. Context, distinct numbered actions in the same cluster, not extra marks: "The \$10 FOI fee will be abolished"; "Any change to Council remuneration will take effect only after the subsequent election." Three Same instruments in one cluster, one mark. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans **Close 2.0** "Re-empower Community Association Land Use Committees (CALUCs) as a mandatory early-stage step for all significant land-use changes." · Commits × Comparable. Binding early CALUC is a neighbourhood-voice instrument, not official-languages and not two LAPs per year. Context, same plank, not a second mark: neighbourhood-based OCP reform; local DCC reinvestment to that neighbourhood's parks, sidewalks, and infrastructure. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) retrieved 2026-09-02
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — No community-survey instrument, no advance-vote or ballot-access reform. Hub 2 "voting is a job interview" is a frame, not an instrument. Mentions dash. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — "This is a shared-services and cost-reduction commitment, not a proposal to amalgamate municipalities or merge governance structures." Explicitly not an amalgamation ask. Hub 2 treats Alto's referendum as an open question to work through, not a yes. Not Opposed to a Program line he has not disagreed with as a vote. Dash. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [campaign home](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/) · [`/platform`](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) (retrieved 2026-09-02; NationBuilder, no Last-Modified header; earlier pack used lastmod 17 Jul 2026) · [Hub 1 Housing](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-1-housing) · [Hub 2 Governance](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-2-governance) · [Hub 4 Budget](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget) · [Hub 6 Safety](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety) · live ACTW profile (verified 1 Sep 2026). Hubs 3/5/7–10 listed on the site were not required once `/platform` plus these four hubs covered the 2026 ask; remaining hubs are diagnostic of 2022–26 Council, not additional 2026 instruments. - **Not a source, applied:** law-professor / construction-lawyer / tribunal background; James Bay residence; Bayview / Roundhouse citizen opposition (not a 2022–26 City vote); June 2026 internal notes of an STR 3% trigger that is **not on the live ****`/platform`**** this retrieve**. - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Twenty-two sentences carry the twenty-two scored cells: (1) family unit-mix → row 1. (2) 99-year leases to co-ops → row 2. (3) pattern book → row 4. (4) suite amnesty → row 5. (5) one-for-one rental replacement → row 21. (6) 90-day inflation consult → row 13. (7) all-in residential estimate → row 15. (8) provincial care framework → row 16. (9) ranked collision list → row 27. (10) downtown business liaison → row 31. (11) community paramedicine → row 32. (12) Esquimalt-style regional integration → row 33. (13) həlisət performance contract → row 35. (14) heritage impact assessment → row 36. (15) ZBB annual baselines → row 41. (16) real-time taxpayer portal → row 42. (17) civic land map + public-benefit report → row 44. (18) net-positive canopy → row 49. (19) 10% material-change rule → row 50. (20) Integrity Commissioner → row 51. (21) lobbyist registry → row 52. (22) binding CALUC → row 53. Provincial BC Transit-gap advocacy and water-transit feasibility were considered for row 28 and dashed (Mentions; not City-controlled transit levers). - **Contested allocations.** Row 4 Aligned 3.0 is the template's own example sentence, re-sourced from live `/platform` this retrieve, not copied. Row 33 Close (not Partial) uses hub 6's regional-integration "I would" rather than `/platform`'s restore-two-positions line; 1 Sep pack was Partial 1.0 on restore-two alone. Row 15 Close treats "residents should demand" on a campaign hub as Commits because he is the candidate for that Council — ambiguity up; could be argued to Partial+ 1.5. Row 44 Close (not Aligned) because M69 also requires sell-or-lease of parcels that do not serve an essential function; inventory plus public-benefit report is the first half only.
